name: Sika FerroGard-901 S
paste:
SIKA® FERROGARD®-901 S: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® FerroGard®-901 S, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/sika_ferrogard_-901s.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® FerroGard®-901 S where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika® FerroGard®-901 S is a liquid concrete admixture based on Sika® FerroGard® technology for use in reinforced concrete and mortar. It acts as a corrosion inhibitor for the steel reinforcement. By using Sika® FerroGard®-901 S, the life expectancy and durability of reinforced concrete can be substantially increased.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® FerroGard®-901 S is designed for reinforced concrete particularly at risk of corrosion. It specifically provides protection from chloride-induced corrosion.
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Typical uses are in.
    - Concrete roads
    - Bridges
    - Tunnels
    - Retaining walls
    - Industrial plants
    - Multi storey car parks

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® FerroGard®-901 S
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Corrosion inhibiting concrete admixture
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. By using Sika® FerroGard®-901 S both the anodic and cathodic reactions of the electrochemical corrosion process are reduced. The product forms a protective layer on the steel surface which delays the onset of corrosion and also reduces the corrosion rate. Sika® FerroGard®-901 S is a combination of organic corrosion inhibitors. The following advantages can be achieved using Sika® FerroGard®-901 S:
    - Corrosion protection for embedded reinforcing steel, especially from chloride attack
    - Protection from the destructive influences of reinforcement corrosion
    - No negative influences on the properties of both the fresh and the hardened concrete
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Amino alcohols
    - Appearance and colour: Green liquid
    - Density: ~1.05 kg/L
    - pH-Value: ~9.5 at +20 °C
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Specific advice: Frozen Sika® FerroGard®-901 S can be used after slow thawing at room temperature, followed by intense stirring.
2.6 Concreting guidance. The standard rules of good concreting practice, concerning production and placing, are to be followed. Laboratory trials shall be carried out before concreting on site, especially when using a new mix design or producing new concrete components. Fresh concrete must be cured properly and curing applied as early as possible.
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: IBC 1000 litre bulk deliveries
    - Shelf life: 12 months shelf life from date of production if stored properly in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging.
    - Storage conditions: Storage at temperatures between 1 °C and 35 °C. Protect from direct sunlight, frost and contamination.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Recommended dosage: 12 kg/m³
4.3 Dispensing. Sika® FerroGard®-901 S is mixed with the gauging water or added at the same time into the concrete mixer. It may also be added to the concrete in the transit mixer at the point of discharge. In this case, an additional mixing time of at least 1 minute per m³ concrete must be observed. Before discharging it, check the concrete visually for uniform consistency. The quantity of Sika® FerroGard®-901 S in the mix design should be taken into consideration when determining the quantity of water for a specific w/c-ratio.
4.4 Compatibility. Sika® FerroGard®-901 S can be combined with many other Sika products. Note: Always conduct trials before combining products in specific mixes and contact Sika® technical service for more information and advice.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® FerroGard®-901 S, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/sika_ferrogard_-901s.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika Ferrogard 901 S, version 09/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/MSDS%20Sika%20FerroGard-901%20S%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® FerroGard®-901 S, version 18/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/sds-sika-ferrogard-901s.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. There are no local restrictions
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
